description: Remove a tag from every monitor and heartbeat that carries it; the items themselves stay, and no tool restores the tag. Use it to retire a tag across the organization; to take it off chosen monitors only use bulk_update_monitor_tags with remove, and to rename it use rename_tag. Requires a key with the write scope. A tag nothing carries is not an error (both counts are 0). Returns from (the tag), monitors_updated and heartbeats_updated.

tag.description: The tag to remove, exactly as list_tags shows it.

name: delete_tag
title: Remove a tag everywhere
